''See also: [[Ancestor's Spear Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|The Ancestor's Spear is a legendary sacred weapon belonging to the [[Jai clan]], characterized by its glowing white shaft of [[Forged madra]] and etched with various [[scripts]]. According to clan legends, the original Jai Matriarch{{!}}Matriarch used this weapon to siphon power from her enemies. In practice, the spear utilizes its [[scripts]] to guide and gather [[madra]], a process that allows its wielder to increase their power more rapidly than other [[sacred artists]]. However, using the weapon's ability to drain [[madra]] can leave a user vulnerable, making it safer to practice on captives rather than active opponents. During a confrontation involving [[Jai Long]], the weapon was used to strike an opponent, though its application was described as lacking refined [[technique]]. The spear's power proved so intense that it interfered with the natural healing processes of a [[Bloodforged Iron body]]. Ultimately, the weapon was destroyed when [[Lindon]] applied [[Blackflame]] to it, causing the shaft to disintegrate into white dust. While the main body of the spear was lost, its glinting white spearhead remained, and a small shard of the artifact was later recovered.}}

== Blackflame ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|The Ancestor's Spear is a glowing shaft composed of [[Forged white madra]] and marked with etched lines of Script{{!}}script. Kept within a protective case, the weapon is white in color despite lacking any [[Stellar Spear madra]]. During combat, [[Jai Long]] utilized the spear to strike a [[Remnant]]'s rib cage and inflicted various cuts upon bodies.}}

== Skysworn ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|Found within a [[labyrinth]], the Ancestor's Spear is a weapon characterized by its white shaft and a single Script{{!}}script etched upon its spearhead. This object functions through the combined use of a Script{{!}}script and [[madra]], though the specific source of its binding{{!}}bindings and energy remains unknown. While it is considered one of the weakest objects in labyrinth{{!}}the labyrinth maze, it possesses the power to inflict wounds that fail to heal properly. During combat, [[Jai Chen]] utilized the weapon to stab [[Jai Daishou]], and it also demonstrated the ability to rapidly advance [[Jai Long]] from [[Highgold]] to [[Truegold]].}}
